File Diff

Shows one file's changes as a diff, even while streaming.

Collapsible primitive
@qinyang/theme@qinyang/icons@qinyang/agent-code-block@qinyang/collapsible@qinyang/loader@base-ui/react@pierre/diffsmotion
@@ -12,9 +12,12 @@ export function BookingForm({ venue }: Props) {
  const [guests, setGuests] = useState(2)
  const [time, setTime] = useState("19:00")
  const [time, setTime] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const slots = useAvailableSlots(venue.id, guests)
​
  async function submit() {
    await book(venue.id, { guests, time })
    if (!time) return
    await book(venue.id, { guests, time })
    toast.success(`Booked for ${guests} at ${time}`)
  }

Installation

$pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @qinyang/file-diff

Usage

import { FileDiff } from "@/components/ui/file-diff"
<FileDiff filename="lib/slots.ts" diff={diff} />

Examples

Split View

Use defaultDiffStyle="split" on wide layouts, and add diffStyleToggle to let the reader switch.

Two Files

Pass oldFile and newFile when you have both versions instead of a patch, so unchanged stretches can fold away.

Accept or Reject Changes

Use lineAnnotations and renderAnnotation for review controls under each change, and diffAcceptRejectHunk to apply the choice to a fileDiff in state.

Collapse on Complete

Set collapseOnComplete when finished diffs should fold away once the agent stops streaming.

Controlled

Control open and onOpenChange when other UI opens the diff, e.g. an expand-all button.

Without Line Numbers or Copy

Turn off showLineNumbers and copyable for compact read-only views.

Pre-parsed Lines

Pass lines when you build rows yourself, and set language when the filename has no extension.

Renderer

The bundled diff renderer draws the rows inside a shadow root, themed with this library's tokens (--code surface, 12px font-mono, success / destructive for changes); light and dark syntax colours follow the html.dark class. It loads on demand in the browser (about 200 KB gzipped, with grammars per language). During static export and until it arrives, plain unhighlighted rows show.

Motion

While status is streaming, the newest row slides in with a primary flash and the view follows the end. Under reduced motion rows appear without movement and the chevron stops rotating.

Accessibility

The header is a collapsible trigger and reads out "N additions, N deletions". The rows sit in a region labelled "Changes to {filename}"; the Unified / Split switch is a radio group.

API Reference

Built on the Collapsible primitive. Only the props this library adds or changes are listed; everything else passes through.

FileDiff

Disclosure for one file change with live +/− counts, rendering a unified or split diff. Also accepts every prop of Collapsible.Root.

filename*
string
File path in the header; the directory part is dimmed. Also infers the language.
diff= ""
string
Unified diff text for one file. Ignored when lines, oldFile/newFile or fileDiff are given.
lines
FileDiffLine[]
Pre-parsed rows, e.g. appended one by one while an agent streams.
oldFile
string | null
Old contents for a two-file diff (null when the file is new). Unchanged regions become expandable.
newFile
string | null
New contents for a two-file diff (null when the file was deleted).
fileDiff
FileDiffMetadata
An already parsed diff (from parseDiffFromFile, parsePatchFiles or diffAcceptRejectHunk). Wins over every other source.
language
string
Syntax language id, inferred from filename when omitted.
status= "complete"
"streaming" | "complete"
streaming shows a spinner, flashes new rows in and follows the end.
open
boolean
Controlled open state.
defaultOpen= true
boolean
Initial open state when uncontrolled.
onOpenChange
(open: boolean) => void
Called when the disclosure opens or closes.
collapseOnComplete= false
boolean
Fold the diff away when status goes from streaming to complete; it reopens when streaming starts again.
diffStyle
"unified" | "split"
Controlled layout.
defaultDiffStyle= "unified"
"unified" | "split"
Initial layout when uncontrolled.
onDiffStyleChange
(style: "unified" | "split") => void
Called when the header switch changes the layout.
diffStyleToggle= false
boolean
Show the Unified / Split switch in the header.
inlineChanges= true
boolean | "word-alt" | "word" | "word-line" | "char"
Highlight the changed part of each modified line. true is "word-alt"; false turns it off.
indicators= "bars"
"bars" | "classic" | "none"
Mark changed lines with a coloured bar, with +/- signs, or by background only.
wrap= false
boolean
Wrap long lines instead of scrolling sideways.
maxHeight= 320
number
Max height of the rows area in px.
showLineNumbers= true
boolean
Show line numbers.
copyable= true
boolean
Show a button that copies the new file contents.
lineAnnotations
DiffLineAnnotation<A>[]
Rows of your own UI pinned under diff lines, each { side: "additions" | "deletions", lineNumber, metadata }.
renderAnnotation
(annotation: DiffLineAnnotation<A>) => ReactNode
Renders each annotation (comments, accept/reject buttons…).
options
FileDiffOptions
Extra renderer options merged over the defaults, e.g. hunkSeparators, expandUnchanged, enableLineSelection.
variant= "card"
"card" | "row"
row drops the card surface and moves the chevron to the end, for lists of files such as EditedFilesCard.
actions
ReactNode
Extra header controls before the copy button (reveal in folder, open in editor).
